verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with percentage-weighted A/B/n variants. Its Experimentation feature runs A/B tests end to end: it serves variations, collects application events into a managed data warehouse, and reads results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine. Together these cover running experiments and determining a winning variation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining custom metrics and how winners are surfaced in the UI, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the experimentation results workflow.
